typography.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-brand-black
typography.font_installation: Add Google Fonts links for Tajawal, Cairo, and Playfair Display in index.html

surfaces.header: Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-border_light) to ensure content scrolls elegantly underneath.
surfaces.product_cards: Cardless flat design. Edge-to-edge images with sharp, clean typography directly underneath. No traditional borders or heavy drop shadows. Hover triggers a subtle image scale.
surfaces.chatbot: Floating action button with rich burgundy gradient and soft drop-shadow-xl. Chat window using Glassmorphism.

visual_enhancers.borders: Minimalist. Use 1px solid #E5E5E5 only where separation is absolutely necessary. Prefer whitespace for separation.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient and soft for floating elements (nav, cart dropdown, chatbot). shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular buttons based on context. Primary CTA (Add to Cart/Checkout) should be Burgundy (#722F37) with white text. Hover state must be darker Burgundy (#5C0B11).
components.inputs: Shadcn UI customized. Minimalist bottom-border only or very light rounded rectangles with focus:ring-1 focus:ring-burgundy.
components.badges: For loyalty points or discounts, use accent gold background with dark text, or burgundy with white text.
components.product_gallery: Use Swiper or framer-motion for smooth image transitions. Main product image takes 60-70% of viewport width on desktop.
components.chatbot: Implement a custom floating widget on the bottom-right (or bottom-left since it's RTL) utilizing Shadcn Dialog/Popover logic customized heavily for luxury aesthetic.
components.whatsapp_integration: A subtle but recognizable WhatsApp icon in the footer or floating above the chatbot.

grids.home_bento: Use an asymmetrical Bento Grid for 'Offers' and 'Categories' on the homepage to break the boring standard squares. e.g., grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6. One span-8, one span-4.
grids.product_grid: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-8. Ensure images have a strict aspect ratio (e.g., aspect-[3/4]).

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, p-16 for sections. The UI should breathe to feel expensive.
layouts.rtl_strategy: CRITICAL: Use Tailwind logical properties (e.g., ms-4 instead of ml-4, pe-6 instead of pr-6, text-start instead of text-left) to ensure flawless RTL rendering.

motion.hover_effects: Image zoom on hover (scale-105) inside an overflow-hidden container. Text fade-ins for product details.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up animations for product grids and hero text using framer-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure white text on Burgundy meets APCA/WCAG standards.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus-visible outlines.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons (cart, wish list, user profile).
accessibility.test_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. E.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button'.

media.aspect_ratios: Products: 3:4 (Tall/Portrait) to showcase clothing. Hero: 16:9 or 21:9.
media.image_handling: Object-cover for all images. Add a very subtle bg-gray-100 placeholder behind images before they load.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building 'Waheeba Fashion' (وهيبة فاشن) - a high-end clothing store.
CRITICAL RTL REQUIREMENT: Add dir='rtl' to the HTML tag. Use logical Tailwind utilities (ms-, me-, ps-, pe-, border-s-, border-e-) to support Arabic direction flawlessly.
Integrate Shadcn UI components but strip away the default 'Vercel' look. Replace heavy borders and drop shadows with minimalist lines and generous padding to achieve an elegant look.
Build the responsive Navigation with a sticky Glassmorphic header. Include links for Home, Products, Offers, About Us, and Contact.
Implement the Product Details Page with a large 3:4 aspect ratio image gallery, color/size selectors, and a prominent Burgundy 'Add to Cart' button.
Include a 'Chatbot' floating widget in the bottom corner (RTL aware, usually bottom-left or bottom-right depending on visual balance, default bottom-left for RTL).
Create a beautiful Offers/Loyalty section using the Accent Gold (#D4AF37) highlighting the rewards program.
The admin dashboard should utilize Shadcn tables and charts with a slightly more dense layout, but still maintaining the brand typography.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and dialogs.
DO NOT apply universal transition like 'transition: all'. Apply to specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container. Respect natural reading flow (RTL).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with hover state animations.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, selection states, loading indicators.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Luxury requires breathing room.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Use Sonner for toasts.
